maria (Docs): FYI infra flipped the canonical idempotency header on v2: Request-Id replaces Idempotency-Key. Need concise migration notes + snippets.

samir (SDK): Okay. Is Idempotency-Key rejected?

maria (Docs): Not rejected immediately. It will be accepted for a 90-day transition window but the server will return a Warning header. After that it will be removed.

clem (Frontend): Our example client uses idempotencyKey by default. I'll update the snippet to requestId and add a one-release shim that logs a console.warn.

samir (SDK): I'll add backwards-compatible mapping idempotencyKey -> requestId and emit a deprecation warning in the SDK. Draft PR: SDK #8133. Snippets below for docs:

samir (SDK): ```js
// old
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-7b', prompt: 'Hi', idempotencyKey: uid })
// new
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-7b', prompt: 'Hi', requestId: uid })
```

samir (SDK): ```py
# old
client.generate(model='redwood-7b', prompt='Hi', idempotency_key=uid)
# new
client.generate(model='redwood-7b', prompt='Hi', request_id=uid)
```

maria (Docs): Add raw HTTP snippet for infra teams and the example response header when Idempotency-Key is used.

maria (Docs): ```http
POST /v2/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer $KEY
Request-Id: 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000
Content-Type: application/json

{ "model": "redwood-7b", "input": "..." }
```

maria (Docs): Server will emit: `Warning: 299 - "Idempotency-Key deprecated; use Request-Id"` if legacy header is present.

jen (QA): I'll add smoke tests: (1) duplicate Request-Id -> deduped, (2) Idempotency-Key -> accepted + Warning header. Plan PR: #8134.

infra-bot: Canary updated: v2 now emits Warning header when Idempotency-Key present.

support-bot: Add KB note: search logs for Warning header and advise customers to switch middleware to Request-Id.

maria (Docs): Action items: samir (SDK PR + snippet tests), clem (frontend examples PR), jen (smoke tests), support-bot (KB draft after docs merge), me (migration guide + checklist). Target: merge docs + SDK changes 48h before outbound deprecation email.

samir (SDK): 👍 aiming to merge within 36h and will ping reviewers.
